rules.statement: The court held that the second defendant's claim for mismanagement damages was limited to the reduction in the value of the estate, and awarded Rs. 5,000 as damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "Considering all the circumstances, we award the 1st defendant Rs. 5,000 as damages on his 2nd claim in reconvention."

meta.parties: Ceylon Estate Agency and Warehousing Co. Ltd. v. De Alvis
